newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish govt body approves sale of PAK power plant.
newsitem.headline: Polish govt body approves sale of PAK power plant.

text.p: The Polish government's economic committee (KERM) approved on Monday a privatisation plan for the Patnow-Adamow-Konin (PAK) power plant, the government press office said in a statement.
Under the plan the treasury would offer between 10 and 20 percent of the plant to investors and raise its capital by 30 percent through a new share issue.
"The process of privatisation will take place in several stages," the statement said.
"It is assumed that investors would increase their holding in the company through successive capital raises," the statement said but gave no further details.
No one at the office was immediately available for comment.
